(4) 'Report export to PDF/Excel' → F-016 → M-010 → 4 LLD files. Total: 25 backend files declared. LLD scope_features [F-013..F-019] maps exactly to all 4 V2 deferred items.

All 5 V2 new tables are represented in both LLD persistence layer and schema.json entities. Mapping: (1) backend/src/infrastructure/db/models/auth.py → tbl_user_master. (2) backend/src/infrastructure/db/models/pricing.py → tbl_price_master + tbl_invoice_header + tbl_invoice_line + tbl_payment. schema.json completeness_check.every_lld_model_in_schema=true and every_schema_entity_in_lld=true (self-declared) — verified by cross-referencing lld_persistence_files_audited[] against schema.entities[]. All 7 read-only reused tables (S1/S2) also documented in schema.json. No persistence-layer LLD file lacks a schema entity; no schema entity lacks an LLD model file.

All new external imports declared in LLD files have deps_manifest entries. New Python packages: passlib[bcrypt] (domain/auth.py CryptContext — DS-018) ✓; python-jose[cryptography] (domain/auth.py JWT signing — DS-018) ✓; reportlab (infrastructure/exporters/pdf_exporter.py — DS-021) ✓; openpyxl (infrastructure/exporters/excel_exporter.py — DS-021) ✓. No new npm/Node packages in V2 backend (frontend deps deferred to V2 UI track per deps_manifest.frontend_deps_note). New env var: SECRET_KEY (required) ✓, ACCESS_TOKEN_EXPIRE_HOURS (optional, default 8) ✓. Migration: 0004_v2_auth_pricing_tables.py ✓. Post-migration script: backend/scripts/seed_default_user.py ✓. Existing packages (FastAPI, SQLAlchemy, Pydantic, Alembic, psycopg) not listed — inherited from S1 as per no_breaking_changes_to[] declaration.

V2 introduces 24 new files (all modification=create) and modifies 2 existing files (dependencies.py + main.py — both correctly listed as modification=modify). No new file path conflicts with any S1/S2/S3 file. New infrastructure/exporters/ directory is novel (no prior sprint used it). New domain/auth.py and domain/invoice.py do not shadow any S1/S2/S3 domain files (domain/stock.py is the only S2 domain file). Modified files are the intended integration points: dependencies.py gets 5 new DI factories + auth infrastructure; main.py gets 6 new include_router calls + global auth guard on all V1 routers — explicitly designed with zero changes to individual V1 router files (scope isolation). Migration 0004 correctly sets down_revision='0003_tx_ledger' (last S2 migration). No S3 migration exists — V3 schema was unchanged, so 0004 follows 0003 correctly.
